# hivelocity_vps_iso (Resource)

Imports an ISO image from a URL into a facility so it can be attached to VPS instances (`hivelocity_vps.iso_id`). The provider waits until the download finishes. ISOs cannot be modified; any change replaces the image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hivelocity_vps_iso" "rescue" {
  name          = "systemrescue"
  description   = "SystemRescue 11"
  url           = "https://example.com/images/systemrescue-11.iso"
  facility_code = "TPA1"
  bootable      = true
}

# Attach it to an instance.
resource "hivelocity_vps" "app" {
  product_id    = 1234
  location_name = "TPA1"
  os_name       = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  hostname      = "app.terraform.test"
  iso_id        = hivelocity_vps_iso.rescue.iso_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bootable` (Boolean) Whether the image is bootable.
- `description` (String) Description of the ISO.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility to store the image in, for example `TPA1`.
- `name` (String) Name of the ISO.
- `url` (String) URL the image is downloaded from.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `device_ids` (List of Number) VPS instances the ISO is attached to.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `iso_id` (String) Unique ID of the ISO.
- `ready` (Boolean) True once the image is downloaded and usable.
- `size` (Number) Size of the image.
- `status` (String) Status of the image.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the ISO ID
terraform import hivelocity_vps_iso.rescue iso-abc123
```
